card.name: Linking words before infection terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words like "of", "or" and "to" just before an infection name or acquisition phrase, such as "reduce the risk of acquiring HIV-1" or "chickenpox or measles".

modes.label: Risk of acquiring infection
modes.description: The word "of" or "acquiring" in phrases about reducing the risk of getting HIV-1 or sexually transmitted infections.

modes.label: Chickenpox or measles
modes.description: The word "or" or "to" linking chickenpox and measles, or exposure to measles, in steroid warnings.
modes.example: More serious or even fatal course of chickenpox<< or>> measles can occur in susceptible patients.

modes.label: Section numbers
modes.description: A digit in a cross-reference to a Warnings and Precautions section number.

card.writes: It slightly favors word starts like "cel", "security" and "safety", which is not a clear medical effect.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words right before a named infection such as HIV-1 or measles.
